sara: Hey team — onboarding new service `vec-store` that needs S3 read + KMS decrypt. I opened a PR to add the IRSA wiring and TF changes: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/482. Quick question: can we reuse the existing `platform-s3-access` role (add condition) or do we need a dedicated role for vec-store? :thinking:

matt: reusing is usually fine if permissions are narrow, but watch the KMS key policy. If the key policy restricts by role ARN you might need a specific role ARN in the policy. Can you paste the TF snippet? :eyes:

sara: sure — current TF in the PR (simplified):
```hcl
module "irsa_vec_store" {
  source = "git::git@github.com:redwood-inference/terraform-modules.git//eks/irsa?ref=v2"

  namespace = "vec-store"
  service_account_name = "vec-store-sa"
  iam_role_name = "platform-s3-access" # trying to reuse
}
```

jen: quick helm/manifest note — if you reuse the role make sure the chart sets `serviceAccount.annotations[\"eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn\"]` to the role arn and not the module output that expects a created role. We had a mismatch last week where helm passed the module output and it was an ARN list.

alex: KMS side: most of our keys have a key policy like "Condition": {"ArnEquals": {"aws:PrincipalArn": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/${some-role}"}}. If you reuse the platform role, update the key policy or add a grant for the vec-store principal. Alternatively add `kms:ViaService` with the S3 source check.

sara: ok i can change the KMS policy in the TF. Is it safe to add multiple role ARNs to the key policy?

matt: safe but messy long-term. Prefer dedicated role when a service needs separation for audits. If vec-store will be multi-tenant or customer-facing, create `vec-store-sa-role`. Otherwise add an explicit ARN to the key policy and call it out in the PR.

jen: also CI check: make sure the `eksctl/irsa` step in the deploy pipeline uses the module output exactly. Ops-bot will fail the pipeline if the SA annotation isn't exact string.

ops-bot: [ci/pipeline] infra/terraform-plan for PR #482 — plan succeeded with 3 changes (2 add, 1 update). See: https://ci.redwood/infraplan/482 :white_check_mark:

alex: one more thing — secrets wiring: vec-store needs a mount of the DB creds from the `vec-store-secrets` secret. In the TF, don't create the secret in the same module that creates the role (we had timing issues). Create the secret first or add `depends_on = [kubernetes_namespace.ns]` so the SA exists.

sara: noted. I'll split the secret creation into a separate step and add KMS policy update. I'll update the PR with a dedicated role option and ask for a final thumbs up. Thanks! :thumbsup:

matt: if you post the alternate TF snippet for dedicated role I'll review asap. Also add a short testing checklist (kubectl commands + how to validate KMS decrypt).

sara: will do — draft checklist:
- kubectl -n vec-store apply -f deploy/serviceaccount.yaml
- kubectl -n vec-store rollout restart deploy/vec-store
- tail logs and look for `AccessDenied` from S3/KMS
- run `aws sts assume-role --role-arn <role> --role-session-name test` to validate assume role path

jen: perfect. i can run the canary in staging once PR merges.

ops-bot: [deploy/staging] vec-store canary started for sha abc123 — monitor at https://deployments.redwood/vec-store :rocket:
